title: Topic 5 テクノロジー
japanese_text:
A：パソコンの充電器、壊れちゃったんだけど、充電器は修理の対象<u>外</u>だから、こういう<u>ケース</u>は買い替えるしかないんだって。<u>電圧</u>とか<u>電力</u>とかよく分からないんだけど、どれ買えばいいかな？
B：えっと…60Wだね。パソコンと同じメーカーのがいいよ。<u>ただ</u>、高いけどね。
english_translation: A: The charger for my computer broke, but chargers aren't included in repairs, so in this case I just have to buy a new one. I don't know much about voltage or power. Which one should I buy? B: Let's see... it's 60W. You should get one from the same manufacturer as your computer. But they're expensive.

annotated_words.meaning_en: not included in ~, outside the scope of ~
